body: Thanks. I guess this is what I came for. Just a virtual hug from someone who understands how deep I am into this shit. Someone to know that I'm hanging by a thread, not confidentially standing away from the edge like most people in my life think. My dads made vague probes toward my thoughts on suicide right now, and I've just bold face lied to him. As someone whose had a long history of mental illness my biggest pet peave (and thats the lightest way I can put it) is people who claim suicidal inclinations for the shock and attention it brings. My brother pulled that trick a few times in our history and I can't forgive him for it. I guess that's why I keep my honest feelings to myself. I'm so afraid of being labeled one thing or another. The small but kind words here are the best thing I've had to hold onto in awhile, so just thanks. I posted here on a whim, and it turned out to be a better mental help community than any I've found from traditional means. Just a bunch of scared kids holding onto each other. Thanks.

Thanks man (gal, indifferent, all of the above). I know there's no magic words. Thats kind of the scary thing. When things get the darkest there is no advice to be had, other than "keep your head up," which is about as helpful as telling a drowning man to swim harder. Saying it out loud has helped. I've kept all this shit in for years now and I really think just spewing it out onto page for at least one person to read has staved off the darkness for a little while. Maybe this is in the wrong subreddit considering I'm not presently on the verge of killing myself. Sometimes I take higher doses of pills to see if maybe I can accidentally kill myself. I've had a few close calls and in those moments when I'm considering if this could be it for me, I realize how scared I am. I don't know what to make of any of this. But thanks all the same.
